page: Microsoft Azure D16pds_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Dpdsv6 family. It is powered by an ARM64-based Microsoft Neoverse-N2 processor featuring 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs operating at 3.4 GHz. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of a 945 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance supports Premium Storage.

Benchmark results indicate strong memory performance, with the Passmark memory score ranking in the top tier (top 10%). Large-block memory bandwidth is also strong (top 25%), reaching 312.21 GB/sec for read-only operations and 125.75 GB/sec for write operations. Single-threaded gzip compression performs in the top 25% at 32.98 GB/sec. Most other compute benchmarks, including Geekbench multi-core (14755.0) and stress-ng multi-core (33160.22), fall within the average range. LLM inference performance is average for small models but drops to the bottom 25% for medium model prompt processing.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ARM64 architecture provides a resource-dense profile with dedicated physical cores, avoiding hyperthreading overhead. The inclusion of a fast 945 GB local NVMe SSD adds significant value for workloads requiring low-latency scratch space. This server is well-suited for general-purpose workloads, database operations, web serving, and software compilation, though it is less optimal for heavy large-language model inference.
description: Microsoft Azure D16pds_v6 is an ARM64-based general-purpose virtual machine from the Dpdsv6 family, running on Microsoft Hyper-V. It features a Microsoft Neoverse-N2 processor with 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs clocked at 3.4 GHz, paired with 64.0 GB of RAM and a bundled 945 GB local NVMe SSD. The instance delivers top-tier memory performance, with Passmark memory scores in the top 10% and strong large-block memory bandwidth. Most compute and database benchmarks, such as Redis SET operations and Geekbench multi-core tests, align with average tier performance. The dedicated core architecture and integrated high-speed local storage offer a cost-effective, balanced profile for multi-threaded applications. This server is highly suitable for database hosting, web serving, software compilation, and general-purpose enterprise workloads.
